_about: webagents skills add / skills remove, the same in both CLIs (2026-09-25).
edits: the editor alone. text is the agent file as written; result is the file after the edit, byte for byte;
error names the refusal (unclosed, not_yaml, not_list, layout), and then the file is not written.
commands: the command in a folder holding files. args is what follows 'webagents skills', agent is -a,
facts is this machine (keys: the variables that have a value; signed_in: webagents login).
out and err are the lines printed; after holds only the files that changed.
Every name a case adds is one both SDKs load, so both run every case.
